# truenas_dataset_unlock (Action)

Unlocks an encrypted dataset (pool.dataset.unlock) with its passphrase or hex key. The secret is used transiently and is not stored in state.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) Full path of the encrypted dataset to unlock, e.g. "tank/secret".

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Force the unlock.
- `key` (String) Hex key for a key-encrypted dataset. Provide this or passphrase.
- `passphrase` (String) Passphrase for a passphrase-encrypted dataset. Provide this or key.
- `recursive` (Boolean) Also unlock descendant datasets sharing the same key.
- `toggle_attachments` (Boolean) Start services/shares that depend on the unlocked dataset.
